resources.string: Changes the language and direction of the app screens.
Frees memory and keeps suggestions fast. Learned words and settings are never touched.
Saves a file you can restore later or on another phone. Clipboard history is not included.
Restores a backup file. Settings and words in the file replace the current ones.
Speech recognition unavailable, tap to set it up
No connection, tap to get the offline pack
Could not listen, tap to retry

Work without Google speech services and without internet. Download the model of each language you want once (Vosk, Apache 2.0) from alphacephei.com: Arabic is about 333 MB, other languages 32 to 144 MB. Wi-Fi recommended.\n\nVoice typing uses only these engines, with no system or Google fallback. It keeps listening until you press stop, using the model of the current keyboard language.
Download interrupted. Check your connection and try again, it resumes where it stopped.
Not enough free storage, about 1 GB is needed.
The downloaded file was damaged. Try again.
Always on: these engines are the only ones used for voice typing.
Words you remove with a long press on the suggestion bar never show up in suggestions and are never learned again. Tap Restore to bring a word back.
No speech model available for this language
Fixes the finished sentence by itself after . ! ? or Enter: spelling, spacing, punctuation and capital letters. Backspace right after undoes it
On-device helpers: turns Arabizi (mar7aba) into Arabic suggestions, adds the question mark at the end of questions, removes accidental repeated words and fixes spacing after punctuation
Typing ( [ { or a quote adds its closing mark and puts the cursor between them. Typing the closing mark steps over it, and Backspace right after removes both
Expansions can use {date}, {time}, {datetime} and {day}, filled in when the shortcut is used
This field does not accept files directly. The file was copied to the clipboard, so paste it into an app that supports files
Too large to save (limit %1$d MB). You can raise the limit in Clipboard settings
Could not read what you copied. The source app may have closed its access, so copy it again
Could not save to the clipboard history, not enough storage
Largest file or image to save
Total storage for the clipboard history
Pinned items are never removed automatically. When the total is exceeded, the oldest unpinned images, files and long texts are deleted first
Some phones, especially Samsung, stop the keyboard in the background and then copies are missed. Set battery usage for this app to Unrestricted
Adjusts key height and the position of the bottom buttons to your screen size, orientation and corner curvature.
Position of the globe and hide buttons is set automatically from the screen corners and navigation style. Turn off auto fit or use manual positions to change it.
Optional large dictionaries that improve spell checking and word suggestions for Arabic. Some are very large downloads, so use Wi-Fi. They work offline afterwards.
Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
Word frequencies from Arabic Wikipedia (Leipzig Corpora). Very large download, around 100 MB or more.
Word frequencies from Arabic news text (Leipzig Corpora). Very large download, around 100 MB or more.
Open source Arabic spell checking word list (Hunspell). Small download.
Dictionary headwords from Arabic Wiktionary. Medium download.
Names, places and terms from Arabic Wikipedia article titles. Large download.
